note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8277 Section 3.2.1 ('When a SAFI-4 or SAFI-128 route is propagated, if the Network Address of Next Hop field is left unchanged, the Label field(s) MUST also be left unchanged.'), peer_forward_facts.go (precomputeNextHop, applyFactsNextHop), forward_next_hop.go (applyEgressNextHopIntent), filter_delta_handlers.go (mpReachNextHopHandler), and both tagged tests. Migrating PeerSettings{NextHopMode: NextHopUnchanged} to PeerSettings{ExportPolicy: setExportNextHopUnchanged(filterapi.Policy{})} with facts.exportPolicy populated drives staticExportNextHop -> nhModeNone identically. Q1: TestLabeledPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels (SAFI-4) and TestLabeledVPNPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels (SAFI-128) assert empty modification ops, byte-identical MP_REACH output, exact label entry/S-bit preservation, and (for SAFI-128) exact 12-octet VPN next hop, RD, label entry, and prefix. Q2: emitting a next-hop rewrite op for next-hop:unchanged or altering/stripping label octets in mpReachNextHopHandler fails empty-ops and exact byte-equality assertions. Q3: isolated SAFI-4 and SAFI-128 unchanged-next-hop inputs with no competing rewrite rules. Q4: covers both SAFI-4 and SAFI-128 conditional preservation; single-polarity positive annotation remains accurate because unchanged next hop emits no op and copies the attribute verbatim by construction, with no non-conformant propagation input to reject.
